title: Phase 1 — trusted authorization + read-only operational status foundation for PAIR Chat (Independent Audit R2 closure)
description: R2 CORRECTION on BASE 5b5ab73 (audited HEAD b183c75; R2-F1/R2-F2; prior F2/F4 accepted). R2-F1: telegram ingress proves only chat-id EQUALITY, not sender authenticity, and no explicit verifiable read grant exists — so `telegram` principals are now UNVERIFIED like `operator`: every scoped section denies UNVERIFIED_IDENTITY; only `admin` (separate bearer credential) reads data. scopeFor() is retained dormant for the Phase-5 verified-grant mechanism. Telegram conversation/draft/ack behavior unchanged; an HTTP regression proves an MC-token caller claiming a foreign telegram:<chat_id> gets zero victim data. R2-F2: proposal suppression no longer derives from status.intents (text topics are not an authorization boundary). turn() gates PAIR_PROPOSAL materialization solely on the server-derived read_only flag — read-only-authenticated turns suppress for ANY wording (false-negative proof incl. GENERIC-intent messages), while MC-token mission requests that merely mention provider/cost/executor topics still mint drafts (false-positive proof). Normal governed proposal/confirmation flow unchanged. Admin credential remains bearer-only and boundary-scoped (F2) and resolveMcAdminToken still enforces strong explicit secrets (F4). Bounded STATUS envelope semantics unchanged; hook still runs only after replay + stale-turn gates and mutates nothing. pair-phase1-http-boundary.test.ts proves R2-F1/R2-F2 over real HTTP.
